summary: You take the three core courses, REES 200 in autumn and winter, REES 300 with a capstone thesis paper, three or more electives and three graduate REEE language courses, toward 48 units, each letter graded with a B or better. At most 3 units with an S grade and 12 units of language count toward the 48, and courses below the 200 level count only if they are language courses. The associate director's approval of every course, electives spread over three disciplines, History courses at the 300 level, approved activity courses and the thesis paper are checked by hand.

program.why: "Coursework qualifying for the 48-unit minimum must have a letter grade of B or higher (B- does not count for degree credit, nor does CR)."

totals.label: S units
totals.why: "Students may apply a maximum of three units of coursework with a final grade of S to the 48-unit minimum. The CREEES associate director must approve S units counting toward the 48-unit minimum."

totals.label: Advanced language units
totals.why: "A maximum of 12 units (four units per quarter) from advanced language work is permitted toward the 48-unit degree minimum."

totals.label: Courses below the 200 level (language courses aside)
totals.why: Electives: "All courses (other than language courses and approved activity courses) must be taken at the graduate level (200-level or higher)". The listing a student took decides the number. OSPGEN 31 is on the pre-approved list, so it is left out of the cap; an approved activity course is moved in by hand.

ne5plvSC.why: "Students must enroll in and complete three (3) designated core courses earning a letter grade of “B” or higher for each course"

878QJWQW.why: "REES200 ... is required of all students in the MA program in autumn and winter quarters (two units total)": two enrollments of the repeatable REES 200.

JZWwiDn7.why: "Elective courses must be distributed among at least three disciplines (e.g., History, Political Science, Slavic Languages and Cultures, etc.)", so at least three electives. "Coursework qualifying for the 48-unit minimum must have a letter grade of B or higher". Courses off the pre-approved list count "through a petition process"; the rest of the 48 units come from the program total.

z3eJ1Oto.why: "Students are required to complete at least 1 REEE ... area language course per quarter (excluding summer), for a total of 3 courses. Any graduate-level course with a subject code of RUSSLANG; ARMELANG; CZECLANG; HNGRLANG; POLSHLNG; ROMALANG; or UKRNLANG will count ... These courses must be taken for a letter grade, and students must receive a grade of B or better. A maximum of 12 units ... from advanced language work is permitted toward the 48-unit degree minimum." Graduate-level is read as numbered 200 and above; other courses count "with the consent of the Associate Director or Faculty Director" and are moved in.
